name: Sendmarc
summary: Sendmarc monitors DMARC reports, helps manage SPF and DKIM records, and offers threat intelligence alerting for spoofing and unauthorized use of a domain. It publishes no paid prices: Premium is quoted, and a free trial covers 1 domain and up to 5,000 emails.

facts.text: Threat intelligence alerting is described as detecting spoofing and phishing attempts, unauthorized use of a domain, and malicious IP addresses trying to spoof it.
Lookalike Domain Defense lists notifications of new domain permutations and a watchlist of existing lookalike domains. The page does not say how often it checks or how alerts are delivered.
The free trial covers 1 domain, up to 5,000 emails, 21 days of data history and 1 portal user. The page does not say how long the trial lasts.
Paid plans are obtained through a Get a quote form, and the page lists no price, currency or billing period.

plans.name: Free Trial
plans.notes: 21 days of data history, aggregate reports, 1 portal user. Trial length not stated

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: DMARC, SPF, DKIM and BIMI management, aggregate and forensic reports, SSO, audit logs

plans.name: Microsoft, Google & Yahoo Compliance
plans.notes: The page lists the same features as Premium

plans.name: Enterprise and Government
plans.notes: Adds a service agreement, project management and supply chain analysis

hiddenCosts: No price is published. Ask a quote to state the unit, term and which features such as lookalike domain alerts are included.
